data.name: Adelphina
data.gender_notes: Adelphina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'adelphos', meaning 'brother'. In Christian context, Adelphina could be a female form of the Greek name Adelphos, meaning 'sister of a dearly loved brother'. The name Adelphina carries the meaning “Sister” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Adelphina usually hope their child will grow to embody sister and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of unity and love within a family.
data.etymology: Adelphina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sister.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adelphina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אדלפינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אדלפינה נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'אדלפוס' שפירושה אח או אחיה, ומוסיף את הסיומת הנשית '-ינה'. הוא מתאר אחות יקרה ומקובלת במשפחה הנוצרית, ומדגיש את הקשר המשפחתי הרוחני בין המאמינים.

in_greek.name: Αδελφίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αδελφίνη προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'αδελφός', που σημαίνει αδελφός ή αδελφή, και προσθέτει τη θηλυκή κατάληξη '-ίνη'. Συμβολίζει την αδελφική αγάπη και την πνευματική οικογένεια των Χριστιανών, τονίζοντας τη σχέση αγάπης και αλληλεγγύης μεταξύ των πιστών.

in_latin.name: Adelphina
in_latin.meaning: Sisterly love in the Christian family
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Adelphina is derived from the Greek word 'adelphos', meaning brother or sister, and adds the feminine suffix '-ina'. It signifies sisterly love and spiritual kinship within the Christian family, emphasizing the bond of love and unity among believers.

in_english.name: Adelphina
in_english.meaning: Sisterly love in the Christian family
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adelphina originates from the Greek root 'adelphos', meaning brother or sister. In Christian tradition, Adelphina symbolizes the spiritual bond of sisterhood among believers. It connotes a sense of unity, love, and mutual support within the Christian community. Historically, the name reflects the early Christian emphasis on spiritual kinship and familial relationships among followers of Christ. Today, Adelphina is used across various Christian cultures to signify a cherished and devoted sister in faith.

data.cultural_impact: Adelphina is a name filled with warmth, love, and familial bonding. It is a vivid reminder of the importance of family relationships and the deep affection between siblings. In many Italian and Greek households, the name Adelphina is cherished and passed down through generations, reflecting the cultural value of familial ties and love.
data.spiritual_significance: Adelphina encourages us to embrace the spiritual bond of sisterhood and brotherhood. This name invites us to reflect on our relationship with God, our Creator, who is the ultimate Brother and Sister to us all. The spiritual significance of the name Adelphina inspires us to support and love one another as if we are truly siblings in the eyes of the Lord, transcending mere biological relationships.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Adelphina, meaning "brotherly," embodies the spiritual bond of love and unity among siblings in the Christian faith. It symbolizes the spiritual connection between believers, emphasizing the importance of fellowship and community in the journey towards God.

historical_references.reference: Adelphina of Capua (d. 1274) was a Benedictine abbess who founded the monastery of Santa Maria di Montevergine.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Adelphina remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Adelphina in New York, United States credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Adelphina, which means "Sister". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
